items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: As a matter of fact, the little piano that I have in my den today, Nat used to play on that piano.

ctx.x: He had a show. There was a show, and I think -- I can't remember the name of his revue. I think his wife was in the show, Nadine was his wife at that time. I think she was a part of this revue. I'll have to get that information out. The next time we do this I'll have to remember this, because I want to be sure that I have the name of the show, you know, that they came out here. And I think, if I'm not mistaken, Nat's brother was in that band at the time, I think. Eddie. Eddie Cole I think was with the band at the…
Cole was a bass player at that time. And later, of course, you know, he started playing piano. He and his wife had an act together, later.
